courses.overview: 從「背面供電網路製程」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Backside power-delivery processing into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合
related.why: 把「背面供電網路製程」與「晶圓對晶圓混合接合」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Backside power-delivery processing with Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 晶圓接合可以為背面加工提供支撐，也可以形成垂直互連；必須先分清接合的用途。
related.transferEn: Wafer bonding can support backside processing or form vertical interconnects; its purpose must be defined first.
related.difference: 背面供電重整電源路徑；混合接合連接兩個器件或晶圓界面，並非每一個支撐接合都含金屬互連。
related.differenceEn: Backside power reorganizes power routing; hybrid bonding connects device or wafer interfaces, and not every support bond contains metal interconnects.
practice: 分別畫出支撐接合與電性接合

practiceEn: Draw support bonding and electrical bonding separately
Mark frontside and backside current paths
List structures that must remain before a carrier is removed

courses.summary:
imec 的魯汶園區是背面供電公開研究的重要地點之一。背面供電把電源與訊號配線分工重新安排，需要同時處理鍵合、薄化、對準、接觸及熱路徑。此課程以公開研究作為技術對話的入口，而不是複製 imec 的內部流程。

地圖定位官方列示的 imec Tower 訪客地址，座標取自官方聯絡頁嵌入的地圖。背面供電由多家研究機構與企業發展；此點不代表唯一發明地，也不揭示實際試驗設備位置。
courses.summaryEn:
imec’s Leuven campus is one important location for public backside-power research. Separating power and signal routing connects bonding, thinning, alignment, contacts and thermal paths. This course uses public research for technical discussion without reproducing an internal imec flow.

The map identifies the officially listed imec Tower visitor address, using the map embedded on the official contact page. Multiple institutions and companies develop backside power; this point is neither an exclusive invention claim nor a location of experimental equipment.
